title: Text the caller during the call
summary: A tool result carries a SWML send_sms, so the handler texts the caller while the voice call is still up. The model never sees a phone number.
scenario: A workshop booking line that texts the agreed appointment time to the caller

evidence: demo barbiera agent.py:1071 send_sms with a short link
sdk function_result.py:741-800 send_sms builds a SWML document with one send_sms verb and hands it to execute_swml
docs apis/rest/webhooks/ai-swaig-tool-webhook: caller_id_num in the tool POST body
